Want smooth skin and seamless makeup without irritation? Here is the ultimate step-by-step face shaving guide! 🪒✨ Pre-Shave (1–2 Days Before) ⛔ Pause Actives: Stop using retinoids, exfoliants (AHAs/BHAs), and strong actives 1–2 days before shaving to prevent irritation or chemical burns. The Routine (Shave at Night) 🌙 Why night? Shaving leaves your pores open and skin sensitive. Shaving before bed lets your skin heal overnight without clogging pores with makeup or environmental pollution! 1️⃣ Double Cleanse: Ensure a completely fresh base free of makeup, sunscreen, and oil buildup. 2️⃣ Apply Your Medium (Never shave dry!): • Oily / Acne-Prone: Pure Aloe Vera Gel 🌵 • Normal / Combination: Gentle Moisturizer 🧴 • Dry / Mature: Lightweight Facial Oil 💧 3️⃣ Shave Correctly: • Pull skin taut. • Shave WITH the direction of hair growth (downward)—never go against it. • Pass over the same spot a maximum of 2 times to prevent razor burn. Post-Shave Aftercare 💧 Rinse & Hydrate: Rinse with cool water only and apply a simple, gentle moisturizer. Skip fancy sheet masks or perfumed skincare—open pores will react! ⛔ Pause Actives: Skip retinoids and exfoliants for 48 hours post-shave. ☀️ Protect: Apply sunscreen religiously every morning to protect your newly exposed skin from UV damage. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
